title: Curbside and autonomous mobility test gates

gates.name: equivalent accessible service
gates.stop: automated option performs worse without an equivalent human option

gates.name: network and weather rollback
gates.stop: vehicle or robot cannot safely enter manual service

decision_rule: A trial may progress only when the current gate passes, the next responsible professional is named, data retention is approved, and the human route remains continuous. No gate converts unknown into known without evidence.
